step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified nodes on the whiteboard:
- Member Security Hub (SecurityHub)
- Member GuardDuty (GuardDuty)
- Management Security Hub (SecurityHub)
- Management GuardDuty (GuardDuty)
- S3 Bucket for Policy Repository (S3)
- Top Lambda function for Member AWS Accounts configuration (Lambda)
- Middle Lambda function for finding filtering and enrichment (Lambda)
- Step Functions (StepFunctions)
- Kinesis Firehose (Firehose)

2. Identified visual edges:
- S3 -> Top Lambda
- S3 -> Middle Lambda
- Top Lambda -> Member Security Hub
- Member Security Hub -> Management Security Hub
- Member GuardDuty -> Management GuardDuty
- Management Security Hub -> Middle Lambda
- Management GuardDuty -> Middle Lambda

3. Sequenced flows logically starting from configuration policies to finding collection and enrichment.
